tagline: Automated video editing tools for content creators.

policies.refund: No refunds after 7 days of purchase.
policies.support: 24/7 live support is available only on the Pro plan. Basic plan users receive email support with 48-hour response times.
policies.trial: A 7-day free trial is available for new users on both plans.

faq.question: What platforms does AutoStream support?
faq.answer: AutoStream supports export to YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and any platform that accepts MP4 files.

faq.question: Can I upgrade from Basic to Pro?
faq.answer: Yes, you can upgrade anytime. You will be charged the Pro price prorated for the remainder of the billing cycle.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes, both plans come with a 7-day free trial. No credit card required to start.
